entries.german:
St. Johann Grabstein des Heinrich Peter Rosenberck † 18. VI. 1441
`Anno MCCCCXXXXI die 18 mensis iunii obiit Henricus Petrus Rosenberck, cantor huius ecclesiae.`
entries.english:
St. John: Gravestone of Heinrich Peter Rosenberck, who died on 18 June 1441.
In the year 1441, on 18 June, Heinrich Peter Rosenberck, cantor of this church, died.
